selection_rule: Lowest 5-rpm-grid offset within [500,1500] at least 1 rpm above the earliest boundary across the fixed unique calibration inputs. Provisional witness-preserving low-severity candidate, NOT an algorithm-performance optimum.
scope: Legacy 12 fixed inputs plus declared deterministic constant/step signals; exact duplicate inputs removed. All used for calibration, none reserved as final evaluation. No falsifier, optimizer or new random sampling.
